review:
Megaways meets the book mechanic, with a panda and an oriental theme. One scroll symbol is wild and scatter, and in free spins it turns into multipliers worth 2x to 10x.

The bonus picks a random expanding symbol to cover its reel. You can buy free spins with any expanding symbol, or pay more to make sure it's a high-paying one. Very high volatility, 10,000x max and a 97.07% RTP. Free spins about once every 189 spins. It's essentially Book of Cats Megaways with pandas.
pros: Excellent 97.07% RTP – among the highest published
